verdict.rationale: Buzz's vision doc claims 'YAML-as-code automation', which implies workflow definitions can be kept as code alongside its built-in git hosting and patch review. The CLI also exposes a workflow approve step, but that gates individual runs rather than reviewing changes to the automation itself. missing for 10: explicit documentation that workflow definitions are versioned in repos, a documented review flow for automation changes, any rollback mechanism for automations, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: buzz workflows trigger --workflow buzz workflows approve --token
